about:
YellowLite was founded in 2009 in Cleveland, Ohio, by former executives from solar technology distribution companies who wanted to make solar energy more accessible to homeowners and businesses. The company began with a mission to democratize solar power and has since grown to operate three offices across the state.

The firm provides turnkey solar energy solutions, handling design, engineering, financing, permitting, installation, and performance monitoring for residential, commercial, and agricultural customers. Its NABCEP-certified team has completed over 4,000 installations across Ohio, Indiana, Michigan, and Pennsylvania. YellowLite also offers energy storage systems, solar leasing with zero down payment, and financing options that allow full system ownership.

Customers range from individual homeowners to farms and municipal buildings; case studies include a family in Solon and Cuyahoga County's 500th solar installation. The company serves the renewable energy sector, focusing on solar photovoltaic and battery storage projects for both small-scale and large-scale applications.

YellowLite differentiates itself through in-house installation crews, live project tracking for clients, and a performance guarantee that promises savings from day one. The founders' original vision—to make solar technology mainstream—continues to drive its service model, which bundles design, financing, and maintenance under one roof.
